description: This PHP class, Twig	emplateWrapper, provides an interface to interact with Twig templates, allowing rendering, streaming, and block management.

classes.name: Twig	emplateWrapper
classes.description: A final class that exposes a Twig template for rendering, streaming, and block management, encapsulating interaction with the underlying Template object.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Outputs the template content as an iterable, producing chunks of data by yielding from the underlying template's yield method.

methods.name: streamBlock
methods.description: Streams a specific block of the template as an iterable by yielding from the underlying template's yieldBlock method.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the rendered template as a string given the provided context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the template directly, passing the context and internal block arguments to the underlying template's display method.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block with the given name exists within the template, considering the context.

methods.name: getBlockNames
methods.description: Returns an array of all block names defined within the template.

methods.name: renderBlock
methods.description: Renders a specific block by name, merging global variables from the environment.

methods.name: displayBlock
methods.description: Outputs a specific block directly, using the environment globals, iterating over yielded data.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context (e.g., source code and metadata) of the template.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Internal method that returns the underlying template object.
